name: data.gov.uk (CKAN API)

provider.name: UK Government (Government Digital Service / Cabinet Office)

summary: Metadata API for data.gov.uk, the UK government dataset directory, over a keyless CKAN Action API.
description: Search and fetch metadata for datasets published by central government, local authorities and public bodies on data.gov.uk. Returns dataset descriptions, publishers, licences and resource links; the files themselves stay on the publishers' sites. A package_search for 'bus' returned 181 datasets at check.

auth.notes: The guidance page states no API key is needed.

rate_limit.summary: No rate limits per the guidance page (checked today).

endpoints.summary: Search dataset metadata (q, fq, rows, start, sort)
Full metadata and resource list for one dataset

license.name: Open Government Licence v3.0 (site default; each dataset states its own licence)

agent_notes: The documented base is https://data.gov.uk/api/action/ and it 301-redirects to ckan.publishing.service.gov.uk; follow redirects (curl -L). Check each dataset's license_id because many are empty or non-OGL.
caveats: data.gov.uk answers the API path with a 301 to ckan.publishing.service.gov.uk; clients must follow redirects.
One status_show call returned 403 from nginx while package_search, package_show, organization_list and package_list returned 200, so not every CKAN action is exposed.
Many datasets have an empty license_id; the OGL statement is a site-wide default, not a per-dataset guarantee.

verification.notes: Exact example request executed without a key, following one 301.
